name: Pangea: Return to Planet Earth
source:
The story is set in the far future when the Pangea Corp has grown to such a size that it has absorbed all countries and runs 'The Order' which now governs the world. The population is divided into three main groups: 

* the privileged and productive who live under The Order's protection
* the expendables who are basically the psychotic rejects, they live earth's the old cities which are now penal colonies
* the rebels, often called moles, because they live underground now the Earth's surface is barren and hostile

Earth developed the faster than light drive in 2269 and has explored the galaxies. They have come into contact with the three main races that are out there - the Karaskians, Nikonians and Turborans. Among the people whose home is now the stars is Dak, some sort of space mercenary/trader. Dak's father was once the leader of the rebels and the story starts when Dak is asked to return to Earth, to negotiate a treaty between the rebels and the expendables.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/151335/pangea-return-to-planet-earth/]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在遥远的未来，当时盘古大陆集团已经发展到吞并了所有国家的规模，并运营着现在统治世界的“秩序”。人口分为三个主要群体：

* 生活在骑士团保护下的特权阶层和生产力者
*那些基本上是精神病拒绝者的牺牲品，他们生活在地球上的旧城市，现在是流放地
*叛军，通常被称为鼹鼠，因为他们住在地下，现在地球表面贫瘠且充满敌意

地球在2269年开发出比光速更快的驱动器，并探索了星系。他们接触了那里的三个主要种族——卡拉斯基人、尼科尼亚人和图拉人。达克（Dak）是现在以星星为家的人之一，他是某种太空雇佣兵/商人。达克的父亲曾经是叛军的领袖，故事开始于达克被要求返回地球，在叛军和敢死队之间谈判一项条约。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/151335/pangea-return-to-planet-earth/]Mobygames[/url]]
